CustomField.description: When checked, Text and Long Text questions with Max Length show a live character count (e.g. 12 / 100) in the renderer while typing. When unchecked or no hierarchy row applies, the counter stays off. Defaults to false.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: When checked, Text and Long Text questions with Max Length show a live count (e.g. 12 / 100) while typing; the limit is still enforced the same way. If unchecked or no hierarchy row applies to this user, the counter stays off (default).
CustomField.label: Enable Character Countdown
